# Roadmap: Project Manager

## Role overview

Plans scope, schedule, budget and risk for a project.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 5+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Agile & Scrum](../topics/agile.md)

## Also needed

PMP / PMBOK, PRINCE2, Waterfall, MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet

## Where it leads

Grow: Delivery / Program Manager · Lead: Delivery / Program Manager · Pivot: Product Manager (PM)
